audience: brands and stores that run an affiliate program in GoAffPro

useCases.title: Review affiliates by status
useCases.text: List the affiliates of a program with their status, ref code, coupon and group. Search by name, ref code, email or coupon.

useCases.title: Check affiliate sales and commission
useCases.text: List orders tied to affiliates, with commission and approval status, and read the transaction log of each affiliate.

useCases.title: Plan affiliate payouts
useCases.text: Read the amount due to each affiliate up to a date, and the payment requests that affiliates sent from their dashboard.

useCases.title: Review affiliate traffic and coupons
useCases.text: Read the visits that affiliate links sent to the store, and the coupon codes that are assigned to affiliates.

useCases.title: Set an affiliate's status
useCases.text: Approve, reject or set one affiliate to pending. GoAffPro may email the affiliate about the change.

useCases.title: Add a coupon to an affiliate
useCases.text: Add a discount coupon code to one affiliate. This changes the store discounts, and a repeat call can create a second coupon.
